descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S14 Through the screens, each action class (view, save, generate, handoff send) leaves a row naming patient, physician, time and action, in both modes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Every patient access is recorded in the audit log and attributed to the signed-in physician. Each row has the patient, the physician, a timestamp and the action (view / save / generate / handoff send … (UAT OAT-01 step 5; UAT OAT-01 Expected; TFA-94513 AC 7; TFA-94513 AC 12; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given The lane C fixture (one Hospital patient, one Nursing Home resident) plus a second @roundai.test physician as handoff recipient

When In each mode: open the chart (view); type pre-round text and press Save Note (save); press Generate on the encounter (generate); send the handoff in-app to the second physician (handoff send)

Then Each action leaves at least one audit row from this run that matches its predicate: the patient (patient_id), the physician (actor_id), a timestamp and an action that tells view, save, generate and handoff send apart. The view rows name the Hospital patient with context rounding.patient and the resident with context snf.patient, and no row names the other p …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): spec.auditCheck predicates per action class against U5 and UAT 3.3. A missing row, a missing patient_id or actor_id, or a row naming the other patient = Fail. The generate predicate is the ai_disclosure row, not the PHI_WRITE row written when the note is stored, so storing the note cannot pass 'generate'. …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
